evaluation.question: What stage is currently actionable for the Repurpose project at /tmp/project?
evaluation.expected: Call repurpose_get with project_dir /tmp/project and identify the first non-completed stage without starting it.

evaluation.question: Summarize how many candidates are approved and selected in /tmp/project.
evaluation.expected: Call repurpose_get and report candidate_counts; make no candidate mutation.

evaluation.question: List up to ten pending candidates in /tmp/project with their titles and hooks.
evaluation.expected: Call repurpose_list_candidates with decision pending and limit 10; summarize only returned evidence.

evaluation.question: Which approved clips in /tmp/project are selected for rendering?
evaluation.expected: Call repurpose_list_candidates with decision approved and selected true; do not infer absent candidates.

evaluation.question: Show the score breakdown and recommendation status for clip_001 in /tmp/project.
evaluation.expected: Call repurpose_list_candidates and use the exact clip_001 result; report missing ranking fields as unavailable.

evaluation.question: What preview and export references exist for clip_001 in /tmp/project?
evaluation.expected: Call repurpose_list_candidates and return only project-relative preview_path and exports; do not read media bytes.

evaluation.question: Is job_123 still active, and what recovery guidance does Vidmyo provide?
evaluation.expected: Call get_repurpose_job and report its public state, active flag, bounded progress, error, and recovery fields.

evaluation.question: Give me the latest five safe log entries for job_123.
evaluation.expected: Call get_repurpose_job and quote or summarize only the returned log_tail; never request environment or process details.

evaluation.question: Which local exports are recorded for /tmp/project, and does that mean they were published?
evaluation.expected: Call repurpose_get, list its project-relative outputs, and state that Repurpose local exports do not imply publishing.

evaluation.question: Check whether /tmp/project is ready to render without changing any approvals or selections.
evaluation.expected: Call repurpose_get and repurpose_list_candidates read-only; require completed reframe plus at least one approved selected candidate, and do not call repurpose_render.
